description: Fixture-only v0 conditional utility-tilt arena: one shared charge-conditional affine-coupling flow per (variant, model seed), trained by deterministic per-epoch direct sampling from the within-charge nominal or utility-tilted empirical law. Four variants (NOMINAL_PHYSICAL, UA_d0p9_a04, UA_d0p9_a08, UA_d0p1_a01) x three model seeds (11, 12, 13). Architecture, draw budget, and training budget are identical for every variant; only the per-epoch sampling measure changes. Preprocessing is the fixed nominal macro-weighted train-only transform, fit once per model seed and shared by every variant. Not a physical-rate estimate.
